question: Ajay and Bijay are brothers. Meena is the sister-in-law of bijay. Pooja is the sister-in-law of Ajay. Meena and Pooja have no siblings. Dhruv is the son of Meena. Rima is the daughter of pooja. How is Dhruv related to Pooja.
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbol:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2b6936e90e6a7b0bcf7575c8c1c3a4bd0a485faebbd027e44e0f92bfff8e9c1.png] 

Possible tree diagram will be

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9fb8276f9332c098c52317272408f1f4a263d0ea6e63e16627191f5f8eca668d.png] 

Hence, Dhruv is the **nephew** of Pooja.
